{"patch":"[test/release_flow_race_test.dart#A8C7]
INS.POST 924:
+
+  // ── gh-1561 rework — review threads 8/9/10 ─────────────────────────────
+  // Thread 8: read_published_version() must PROPAGATE failure — a command-
+  // substitution call site drops set -e (inherit_errexit is off), so an
+  // API outage used to read as published="" and could drive classification
+  // (worst case: the re-arm force-push) on NO data at all. Thread 9: the
+  // registration wait's fetch_runs is guarded like the terminal-wait loop
+  // (#1370 doctrine). Thread 10: the mint's least-privilege ceiling must
+  // ride an input the pinned action actually honors.
+  group('gh-1561 rework — pub.dev outage semantics + guarded registration wait', () {
+    test('pub.dev API down at the top of the leg -> loud classify failure', () {
+      // Pre-PR semantics restored (thread 8): the top-of-leg read ran in
+      // the main shell under set -e and one failed read exited loudly. The
+      // extracted helper must reproduce that — an outage must never read
+      // as published="" and slip into the behind-classification.
+      final r = runVerify('api-down-top', pubdevApiDown: true);
+      expect(r.exitCode, isNot(0), reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('::error::pub.dev API unreachable — cannot classify'),
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.status,
+        isNot('release-in-flight'),
+        reason: 'no data must never masquerade as a neutral skip',
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog,
+        isEmpty,
+        reason: 'the leg dies at the top read — no classification or '
+            'recovery reads on empty data',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('API outage must never fire the re-arm (no recovery on empty data)', () {
+      // The headline consequence from review thread 8: with published=""
+      // the old code classified «behind», reached the never-triggered arm
+      // and FORCE-PUSHED the tag purely because the API was unreachable.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'api-down-no-rearm',
+        tagAge: const Duration(hours: 2),
+        runsJson:
+            '[{"databaseId":777,"status":"completed","conclusion":"success","event":"release"}]',
+        rearmPushTo: 'origin',
+        pubdevApiDown: true,
+        extraEnv: const {'RELEASE_APP_TOKEN': 'stub-token'},
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, isNot(0), reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('::error::pub.dev API unreachable — cannot classify'),
+      );
+      expect(r.output, isNot(contains('re-armed')), reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog.where((l) => l.contains('--branch v0.1.497')),
+        isEmpty,
+        reason: 'no run-list reads -> no re-arm decision, ever',
+      );
+      // The seeded 2h-backdated tag object is UNTOUCHED — the re-arm (a
+      // state-changing force-push + full ci.yml cascade) never fired.
+      final taggerDate = int.parse(
+        _gitOut([
+          'for-each-ref',
+          'refs/tags/v0.1.497',
+          '--format=%(creatordate:unix)',
+        ], cwd: r.origin),
+      );
+      final actual = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(
+        taggerDate * 1000,
+        isUtc: true,
+      );
+      expect(
+        actual.isBefore(
+          DateTime.now().toUtc().subtract(const Duration(minutes: 90)),
+        ),
+        isTrue,
+        reason: 'the seeded backdate survives — the re-arm never fired',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('pub.dev goes down mid-leg at the success re-read -> neutral skip', () {
+      // The second call site (thread 8): the top-of-leg reads serve the
+      // stale replica, the push run is green, then the API drops before the
+      // success-branch re-read — outcome UNOBSERVED, never a false
+      // «publish did not upload» and never a false green.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'api-down-success-reread',
+        runsJson:
+            '[{"databaseId":4242,"status":"completed","conclusion":"success","event":"push"}]',
+        curlFailAfterReads: 3,
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, 0, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.inFlight, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isFalse, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.output, contains('outcome unobserved'));
+      expect(r.output, isNot(contains('publish did not upload')));
+    });
+
+    test('transient gh failure inside the registration wait -> still-pending, '
+        'never a dead leg (thread 9)', () {
+      // The 4th branch-list read (the 2nd registration read) fails
+      // transiently — under set -e the unguarded assignment used to kill
+      // the leg exactly when the self-heal was mid-flight.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'rearm-gh-blip',
+        tagAge: const Duration(hours: 2),
+        runsJson: '[]',
+        secondReadJson: '[]',
+        rearmPushTo: 'origin',
+        ghListFailOnRead: 4,
+        extraEnv: const {'RELEASE_APP_TOKEN': 'stub-token'},
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, 0, reason: 'a gh blip must not kill the leg: ${r.output}');
+      expect(r.inFlight, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isFalse, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.output, contains('was re-armed by this leg'));
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('transient gh failure reading the run list (attempt 2/6)'),
+        reason: r.output,
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog.where((l) => l.contains('--branch v0.1.497')),
+        hasLength(8),
+        reason: 'the failed read still consumed its registration attempt',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('wiring: the pubdev mint ceiling rides the WORKING granular input '
+        '(thread 10)', () {
+      // Verified against the pinned action (v3.2.0, bcd2ba49): action.yml
+      // defines NO composite `permissions` input (GitHub warns `Unexpected
+      // input(s) 'permissions'` and the action never reads it — the
+      // round-1 author reply was right), but it DOES define the generated
+      // `permission-*` inputs, which the action turns into the mint
+      // request's permissions map. The ceiling must ride the honored input.
+      final daily = read('.github/workflows/daily-publish.yml');
+      final mintAt = daily.indexOf('actions/create-github-app-token@');
+      expect(
+        mintAt,
+        greaterThan(-1),
+        reason: 'the pubdev leg mints the re-arm token',
+      );
+      final mintEnd = daily.indexOf('- name: Verify pub.dev', mintAt);
+      expect(mintEnd, greaterThan(mintAt));
+      final mintBlock = daily.substring(mintAt, mintEnd);
+      expect(
+        mintBlock,
+        contains('permission-contents: write'),
+        reason: 'the least-privilege ceiling (contents:write — the tag '
+            're-push) must come from the honored input',
+      );
+      expect(
+        mintBlock,
+        isNot(contains(RegExp(r'^\s*permissions:', multiLine: true))),
+        reason: 'the composite `permissions` key is dead at this pin — '
+            'keeping it would overclaim a ceiling that does not exist',
+      );
+    });
+  });"}

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Tag/schedule
# runs are never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   installer-portability → gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the POSIX-dialect proof
#               for the first-run wizard (site/** or the generator
#               touched) — dash + busybox ash on ubuntu, bash on macOS;
#               red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
#               per-shard coverage merged to ONE report, junit durations
#               feed shard-rebalance.yml; goldens excluded as before)
#   faui-coverage → merge the 3 fa_ui shard reports into ONE lcov
#                   (issue #283 E3: the gate never sees 3 competing uploads)
#   quality-gate → ONE aggregate required check (skip-tolerant)
#   step-timings → per-step duration telemetry (jobs API → summary+artifact)
#   watchdog   → >2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out leg means a degraded
#                runner allocation → ONE empty-commit retrigger, never
#                `gh run rerun` (a rerun reallocates into the same pool)
#   release-pending → gh-1551 empty-tick short-circuit: the schedule is
#                the release arming mechanism (gh-1537), but a tick with
#                no commits since the last v* tag skips the whole gate
#                in seconds (see the job comment below)
# Tag-only / main-only jobs (publish, binaries, installer-smoke, release,
#   integration) are unchanged in semantics — they just need the new aggregate.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

+      // the main shell under set -e and one failed read exited loudly. The
+      // extracted helper must reproduce that — an outage must never read
+      // as published="" and slip into the behind-classification.
+      final r = runVerify('api-down-top', pubdevApiDown: true);

+      expect(r.errored, isTrue, reason: r.output);

+      // The headline consequence from review thread 8: with published=""
+      // the old code classified «behind», reached the never-triggered arm
+      // and FORCE-PUSHED the tag purely because the API was unreachable.
+      final r = runVerify(

+        tagAge: const Duration(hours: 2),

+        rearmPushTo: 'origin',

+      expect(r.exitCode, isNot(0), reason: r.output);

+read_published_version() {
+  local acc="" v attempt ok=1
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   installer-portability → gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the POSIX-dialect proof
#               for the first-run wizard (site/** or the generator
#               touched) — dash + busybox ash on ubuntu, bash on macOS;
#               red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
#               per-shard coverage merged to ONE report, junit durations
#               feed shard-rebalance.yml; goldens excluded as before)
#   faui-coverage → merge the 3 fa_ui shard reports into ONE lcov
#                   (issue #283 E3: the gate never sees 3 competing uploads)
#   quality-gate → ONE aggregate required check (skip-tolerant)
#   step-timings → per-step duration telemetry (jobs API → summary+artifact)
#   watchdog   → >2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out leg means a degraded

+      // the main shell under set -e and one failed read exited loudly. The
+      // extracted helper must reproduce that — an outage must never read
+      // as published="" and slip into the behind-classification.

+    });

+      // The headline consequence from review thread 8: with published=""
+      // the old code classified «behind», reached the never-triggered arm

{"patch":"[scripts/verify_pubdev_release.sh#A9F2]
SWAP 121.=133:
+read_published_version() {
+  local acc="" v attempt ok=1
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    if v=$(curl -fsS --retry 3 \
+      https://pub.dev/api/packages/flutter_agent_harness | jq -r '.latest.version'); then
+      ok=0
+    fi
+    acc=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$acc" "$v" | sed '/^$/d' | sort -V | tail -1)
+    [ "$attempt" = 3 ] || sleep "$read_sleep"
+  done
+  # gh-1561 rework (review thread 8): a command-substitution subshell does
+  # NOT inherit set -e (inherit_errexit is off), so a failing loop would
+  # silently fall through to the printf — propagating an empty read into
+  # the classification. Return the failure explicitly; callers decide.
+  [ "$ok" -eq 0 ] || return 1
+  printf '%s' "$acc"
+}

+# Top of the leg — the pre-PR inline loop ran in the main shell under

+published=$(read_published_version) || {

# green — never a silent absence, never 35-40 min for an empty tick).
    - cron: '23 */2 * * *'

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Tag/schedule
# runs are never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   installer-portability → gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the POSIX-dialect proof
#               for the first-run wizard (site/** or the generator

{"patch":"[test/release_flow_race_test.dart#A8C7]
INS.POST 924:
+
+  // ── gh-1561 rework — review threads 8/9/10 ─────────────────────────────
+  // Thread 8: read_published_version() must PROPAGATE failure — a command-
+  // substitution call site drops set -e (inherit_errexit is off), so an
+  // API outage used to read as published="" and could drive classification
+  // (worst case: the re-arm force-push) on NO data at all. Thread 9: the
+  // registration wait's fetch_runs is guarded like the terminal-wait loop
+  // (#1370 doctrine). Thread 10: the mint's least-privilege ceiling must
+  // ride an input the pinned action actually honors.
+  group('gh-1561 rework — pub.dev outage semantics + guarded registration wait', () {
+    test('pub.dev API down at the top of the leg -> loud classify failure', () {
+      // Pre-PR semantics restored (thread 8): the top-of-leg read ran in
+      // the main shell under set -e and one failed read exited loudly. The
+      // extracted helper must reproduce that — an outage must never read
+      // as published="" and slip into the behind-classification.
+      final r = runVerify('api-down-top', pubdevApiDown: true);
+      expect(r.exitCode, isNot(0), reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('::error::pub.dev API unreachable — cannot classify'),
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.status,
+        isNot('release-in-flight'),
+        reason: 'no data must never masquerade as a neutral skip',
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog,
+        isEmpty,
+        reason: 'the leg dies at the top read — no classification or '
+            'recovery reads on empty data',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('API outage must never fire the re-arm (no recovery on empty data)', () {
+      // The headline consequence from review thread 8: with published=""
+      // the old code classified «behind», reached the never-triggered arm
+      // and FORCE-PUSHED the tag purely because the API was unreachable.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'api-down-no-rearm',
+        tagAge: const Duration(hours: 2),
+        runsJson:
+            '[{"databaseId":777,"status":"completed","conclusion":"success","event":"release"}]',
+        rearmPushTo: 'origin',
+        pubdevApiDown: true,
+        extraEnv: const {'RELEASE_APP_TOKEN': 'stub-token'},
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, isNot(0), reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('::error::pub.dev API unreachable — cannot classify'),
+      );
+      expect(r.output, isNot(contains('re-armed')), reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog.where((l) => l.contains('--branch v0.1.497')),
+        isEmpty,
+        reason: 'no run-list reads -> no re-arm decision, ever',
+      );
+      // The seeded 2h-backdated tag object is UNTOUCHED — the re-arm (a
+      // state-changing force-push + full ci.yml cascade) never fired.
+      final taggerDate = int.parse(
+        _gitOut([
+          'for-each-ref',
+          'refs/tags/v0.1.497',
+          '--format=%(creatordate:unix)',
+        ], cwd: r.origin),
+      );
+      final actual = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(
+        taggerDate * 1000,
+        isUtc: true,
+      );
+      expect(
+        actual.isBefore(
+          DateTime.now().toUtc().subtract(const Duration(minutes: 90)),
+        ),
+        isTrue,
+        reason: 'the seeded backdate survives — the re-arm never fired',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('pub.dev goes down mid-leg at the success re-read -> neutral skip', () {
+      // The second call site (thread 8): the top-of-leg reads serve the
+      // stale replica, the push run is green, then the API drops before the
+      // success-branch re-read — outcome UNOBSERVED, never a false
+      // «publish did not upload» and never a false green.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'api-down-success-reread',
+        runsJson:
+            '[{"databaseId":4242,"status":"completed","conclusion":"success","event":"push"}]',
+        curlFailAfterReads: 3,
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, 0, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.inFlight, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isFalse, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.output, contains('outcome unobserved'));
+      expect(r.output, isNot(contains('publish did not upload')));
+    });
+
+    test('transient gh failure inside the registration wait -> still-pending, '
+        'never a dead leg (thread 9)', () {
+      // The 4th branch-list read (the 2nd registration read) fails
+      // transiently — under set -e the unguarded assignment used to kill
+      // the leg exactly when the self-heal was mid-flight.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'rearm-gh-blip',
+        tagAge: const Duration(hours: 2),
+        runsJson: '[]',
+        secondReadJson: '[]',
+        rearmPushTo: 'origin',
+        ghListFailOnRead: 4,
+        extraEnv: const {'RELEASE_APP_TOKEN': 'stub-token'},
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, 0, reason: 'a gh blip must not kill the leg: ${r.output}');
+      expect(r.inFlight, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isFalse, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.output, contains('was re-armed by this leg'));
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('transient gh failure reading the run list (attempt 2/6)'),
+        reason: r.output,
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog.where((l) => l.contains('--branch v0.1.497')),
+        hasLength(8),
+        reason: 'the failed read still consumed its registration attempt',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('wiring: the pubdev mint ceiling rides the WORKING granular input '
+        '(thread 10)', () {
+      // Verified against the pinned action (v3.2.0, bcd2ba49): action.yml
+      // defines NO composite `permissions` input (GitHub warns `Unexpected
+      // input(s) 'permissions'` and the action never reads it — the
+      // round-1 author reply was right), but it DOES define the generated
+      // `permission-*` inputs, which the action turns into the mint
+      // request's permissions map. The ceiling must ride the honored input.
+      final daily = read('.github/workflows/daily-publish.yml');
+      final mintAt = daily.indexOf('actions/create-github-app-token@');
+      expect(
+        mintAt,
+        greaterThan(-1),
+        reason: 'the pubdev leg mints the re-arm token',
+      );
+      final mintEnd = daily.indexOf('- name: Verify pub.dev', mintAt);
+      expect(mintEnd, greaterThan(mintAt));
+      final mintBlock = daily.substring(mintAt, mintEnd);
+      expect(
+        mintBlock,
+        contains('permission-contents: write'),
+        reason: 'the least-privilege ceiling (contents:write — the tag '
+            're-push) must come from the honored input',
+      );
+      expect(
+        mintBlock,
+        isNot(contains(RegExp(r'^\s*permissions:', multiLine: true))),
+        reason: 'the composite `permissions` key is dead at this pin — '
+            'keeping it would overclaim a ceiling that does not exist',
+      );
+    });
+  });"}

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Tag/schedule
# runs are never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   installer-portability → gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the POSIX-dialect proof
#               for the first-run wizard (site/** or the generator
#               touched) — dash + busybox ash on ubuntu, bash on macOS;
#               red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
#               per-shard coverage merged to ONE report, junit durations
#               feed shard-rebalance.yml; goldens excluded as before)
#   faui-coverage → merge the 3 fa_ui shard reports into ONE lcov
#                   (issue #283 E3: the gate never sees 3 competing uploads)
#   quality-gate → ONE aggregate required check (skip-tolerant)
#   step-timings → per-step duration telemetry (jobs API → summary+artifact)
#   watchdog   → >2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out leg means a degraded
#                runner allocation → ONE empty-commit retrigger, never
#                `gh run rerun` (a rerun reallocates into the same pool)
#   release-pending → gh-1551 empty-tick short-circuit: the schedule is
#                the release arming mechanism (gh-1537), but a tick with
#                no commits since the last v* tag skips the whole gate
#                in seconds (see the job comment below)
# Tag-only / main-only jobs (publish, binaries, installer-smoke, release,
#   integration) are unchanged in semantics — they just need the new aggregate.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{"patch":"[test/release_flow_race_test.dart#A8C7]
INS.POST 924:
+
+  // ── gh-1561 rework — review threads 8/9/10 ─────────────────────────────
+  // Thread 8: read_published_version() must PROPAGATE failure — a command-
+  // substitution call site drops set -e (inherit_errexit is off), so an
+  // API outage used to read as published="" and could drive classification
+  // (worst case: the re-arm force-push) on NO data at all. Thread 9: the
+  // registration wait's fetch_runs is guarded like the terminal-wait loop
+  // (#1370 doctrine). Thread 10: the mint's least-privilege ceiling must
+  // ride an input the pinned action actually honors.
+  group('gh-1561 rework — pub.dev outage semantics + guarded registration wait', () {
+    test('pub.dev API down at the top of the leg -> loud classify failure', () {
+      // Pre-PR semantics restored (thread 8): the top-of-leg read ran in
+      // the main shell under set -e and one failed read exited loudly. The
+      // extracted helper must reproduce that — an outage must never read
+      // as published="" and slip into the behind-classification.
+      final r = runVerify('api-down-top', pubdevApiDown: true);
+      expect(r.exitCode, isNot(0), reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('::error::pub.dev API unreachable — cannot classify'),
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.status,
+        isNot('release-in-flight'),
+        reason: 'no data must never masquerade as a neutral skip',
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog,
+        isEmpty,
+        reason: 'the leg dies at the top read — no classification or '
+            'recovery reads on empty data',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('API outage must never fire the re-arm (no recovery on empty data)', () {
+      // The headline consequence from review thread 8: with published=""
+      // the old code classified «behind», reached the never-triggered arm
+      // and FORCE-PUSHED the tag purely because the API was unreachable.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'api-down-no-rearm',
+        tagAge: const Duration(hours: 2),
+        runsJson:
+            '[{"databaseId":777,"status":"completed","conclusion":"success","event":"release"}]',
+        rearmPushTo: 'origin',
+        pubdevApiDown: true,
+        extraEnv: const {'RELEASE_APP_TOKEN': 'stub-token'},
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, isNot(0), reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('::error::pub.dev API unreachable — cannot classify'),
+      );
+      expect(r.output, isNot(contains('re-armed')), reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog.where((l) => l.contains('--branch v0.1.497')),
+        isEmpty,
+        reason: 'no run-list reads -> no re-arm decision, ever',
+      );
+      // The seeded 2h-backdated tag object is UNTOUCHED — the re-arm (a
+      // state-changing force-push + full ci.yml cascade) never fired.
+      final taggerDate = int.parse(
+        _gitOut([
+          'for-each-ref',
+          'refs/tags/v0.1.497',
+          '--format=%(creatordate:unix)',
+        ], cwd: r.origin),
+      );
+      final actual = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(
+        taggerDate * 1000,
+        isUtc: true,
+      );
+      expect(
+        actual.isBefore(
+          DateTime.now().toUtc().subtract(const Duration(minutes: 90)),
+        ),
+        isTrue,
+        reason: 'the seeded backdate survives — the re-arm never fired',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('pub.dev goes down mid-leg at the success re-read -> neutral skip', () {
+      // The second call site (thread 8): the top-of-leg reads serve the
+      // stale replica, the push run is green, then the API drops before the
+      // success-branch re-read — outcome UNOBSERVED, never a false
+      // «publish did not upload» and never a false green.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'api-down-success-reread',
+        runsJson:
+            '[{"databaseId":4242,"status":"completed","conclusion":"success","event":"push"}]',
+        curlFailAfterReads: 3,
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, 0, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.inFlight, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isFalse, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.output, contains('outcome unobserved'));
+      expect(r.output, isNot(contains('publish did not upload')));
+    });
+
+    test('transient gh failure inside the registration wait -> still-pending, '
+        'never a dead leg (thread 9)', () {
+      // The 4th branch-list read (the 2nd registration read) fails
+      // transiently — under set -e the unguarded assignment used to kill
+      // the leg exactly when the self-heal was mid-flight.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'rearm-gh-blip',
+        tagAge: const Duration(hours: 2),
+        runsJson: '[]',
+        secondReadJson: '[]',
+        rearmPushTo: 'origin',
+        ghListFailOnRead: 4,
+        extraEnv: const {'RELEASE_APP_TOKEN': 'stub-token'},
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, 0, reason: 'a gh blip must not kill the leg: ${r.output}');
+      expect(r.inFlight, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isFalse, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.output, contains('was re-armed by this leg'));
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('transient gh failure reading the run list (attempt 2/6)'),
+        reason: r.output,
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog.where((l) => l.contains('--branch v0.1.497')),
+        hasLength(8),
+        reason: 'the failed read still consumed its registration attempt',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('wiring: the pubdev mint ceiling rides the WORKING granular input '
+        '(thread 10)', () {
+      // Verified against the pinned action (v3.2.0, bcd2ba49): action.yml
+      // defines NO composite `permissions` input (GitHub warns `Unexpected
+      // input(s) 'permissions'` and the action never reads it — the
+      // round-1 author reply was right), but it DOES define the generated
+      // `permission-*` inputs, which the action turns into the mint
+      // request's permissions map. The ceiling must ride the honored input.
+      final daily = read('.github/workflows/daily-publish.yml');
+      final mintAt = daily.indexOf('actions/create-github-app-token@');
+      expect(
+        mintAt,
+        greaterThan(-1),
+        reason: 'the pubdev leg mints the re-arm token',
+      );
+      final mintEnd = daily.indexOf('- name: Verify pub.dev', mintAt);
+      expect(mintEnd, greaterThan(mintAt));
+      final mintBlock = daily.substring(mintAt, mintEnd);
+      expect(
+        mintBlock,
+        contains('permission-contents: write'),
+        reason: 'the least-privilege ceiling (contents:write — the tag '
+            're-push) must come from the honored input',
+      );
+      expect(
+        mintBlock,
+        isNot(contains(RegExp(r'^\s*permissions:', multiLine: true))),
+        reason: 'the composite `permissions` key is dead at this pin — '
+            'keeping it would overclaim a ceiling that does not exist',
+      );
+    });
+  });"}

+read_published_version() {
+  local acc="" v attempt ok=1
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   installer-portability → gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the POSIX-dialect proof
#               for the first-run wizard (site/** or the generator
#               touched) — dash + busybox ash on ubuntu, bash on macOS;
#               red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,

#                   (issue #283 E3: the gate never sees 3 competing uploads)
#   quality-gate → ONE aggregate required check (skip-tolerant)
#   step-timings → per-step duration telemetry (jobs API → summary+artifact)

{"patch":"[test/release_flow_race_test.dart#A8C7]
INS.POST 924:
+
+  // ── gh-1561 rework — review threads 8/9/10 ─────────────────────────────
+  // Thread 8: read_published_version() must PROPAGATE failure — a command-
+  // substitution call site drops set -e (inherit_errexit is off), so an
+  // API outage used to read as published="" and could drive classification
+  // (worst case: the re-arm force-push) on NO data at all. Thread 9: the
+  // registration wait's fetch_runs is guarded like the terminal-wait loop
+  // (#1370 doctrine). Thread 10: the mint's least-privilege ceiling must
+  // ride an input the pinned action actually honors.
+  group('gh-1561 rework — pub.dev outage semantics + guarded registration wait', () {
+    test('pub.dev API down at the top of the leg -> loud classify failure', () {
+      // Pre-PR semantics restored (thread 8): the top-of-leg read ran in
+      // the main shell under set -e and one failed read exited loudly. The
+      // extracted helper must reproduce that — an outage must never read
+      // as published="" and slip into the behind-classification.
+      final r = runVerify('api-down-top', pubdevApiDown: true);
+      expect(r.exitCode, isNot(0), reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('::error::pub.dev API unreachable — cannot classify'),
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.status,
+        isNot('release-in-flight'),
+        reason: 'no data must never masquerade as a neutral skip',
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog,
+        isEmpty,
+        reason: 'the leg dies at the top read — no classification or '
+            'recovery reads on empty data',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('API outage must never fire the re-arm (no recovery on empty data)', () {
+      // The headline consequence from review thread 8: with published=""
+      // the old code classified «behind», reached the never-triggered arm
+      // and FORCE-PUSHED the tag purely because the API was unreachable.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'api-down-no-rearm',
+        tagAge: const Duration(hours: 2),
+        runsJson:
+            '[{"databaseId":777,"status":"completed","conclusion":"success","event":"release"}]',
+        rearmPushTo: 'origin',
+        pubdevApiDown: true,
+        extraEnv: const {'RELEASE_APP_TOKEN': 'stub-token'},
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, isNot(0), reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('::error::pub.dev API unreachable — cannot classify'),
+      );
+      expect(r.output, isNot(contains('re-armed')), reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog.where((l) => l.contains('--branch v0.1.497')),
+        isEmpty,
+        reason: 'no run-list reads -> no re-arm decision, ever',
+      );
+      // The seeded 2h-backdated tag object is UNTOUCHED — the re-arm (a
+      // state-changing force-push + full ci.yml cascade) never fired.
+      final taggerDate = int.parse(
+        _gitOut([
+          'for-each-ref',
+          'refs/tags/v0.1.497',
+          '--format=%(creatordate:unix)',
+        ], cwd: r.origin),
+      );
+      final actual = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(
+        taggerDate * 1000,
+        isUtc: true,
+      );
+      expect(
+        actual.isBefore(
+          DateTime.now().toUtc().subtract(const Duration(minutes: 90)),
+        ),
+        isTrue,
+        reason: 'the seeded backdate survives — the re-arm never fired',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('pub.dev goes down mid-leg at the success re-read -> neutral skip', () {
+      // The second call site (thread 8): the top-of-leg reads serve the
+      // stale replica, the push run is green, then the API drops before the
+      // success-branch re-read — outcome UNOBSERVED, never a false
+      // «publish did not upload» and never a false green.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'api-down-success-reread',
+        runsJson:
+            '[{"databaseId":4242,"status":"completed","conclusion":"success","event":"push"}]',
+        curlFailAfterReads: 3,
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, 0, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.inFlight, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isFalse, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.output, contains('outcome unobserved'));
+      expect(r.output, isNot(contains('publish did not upload')));
+    });
+
+    test('transient gh failure inside the registration wait -> still-pending, '
+        'never a dead leg (thread 9)', () {
+      // The 4th branch-list read (the 2nd registration read) fails
+      // transiently — under set -e the unguarded assignment used to kill
+      // the leg exactly when the self-heal was mid-flight.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'rearm-gh-blip',
+        tagAge: const Duration(hours: 2),
+        runsJson: '[]',
+        secondReadJson: '[]',
+        rearmPushTo: 'origin',
+        ghListFailOnRead: 4,
+        extraEnv: const {'RELEASE_APP_TOKEN': 'stub-token'},
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, 0, reason: 'a gh blip must not kill the leg: ${r.output}');
+      expect(r.inFlight, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isFalse, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.output, contains('was re-armed by this leg'));
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('transient gh failure reading the run list (attempt 2/6)'),
+        reason: r.output,
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog.where((l) => l.contains('--branch v0.1.497')),
+        hasLength(8),
+        reason: 'the failed read still consumed its registration attempt',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('wiring: the pubdev mint ceiling rides the WORKING granular input '
+        '(thread 10)', () {
+      // Verified against the pinned action (v3.2.0, bcd2ba49): action.yml
+      // defines NO composite `permissions` input (GitHub warns `Unexpected
+      // input(s) 'permissions'` and the action never reads it — the
+      // round-1 author reply was right), but it DOES define the generated
+      // `permission-*` inputs, which the action turns into the mint
+      // request's permissions map. The ceiling must ride the honored input.
+      final daily = read('.github/workflows/daily-publish.yml');
+      final mintAt = daily.indexOf('actions/create-github-app-token@');
+      expect(
+        mintAt,
+        greaterThan(-1),
+        reason: 'the pubdev leg mints the re-arm token',
+      );
+      final mintEnd = daily.indexOf('- name: Verify pub.dev', mintAt);
+      expect(mintEnd, greaterThan(mintAt));
+      final mintBlock = daily.substring(mintAt, mintEnd);
+      expect(
+        mintBlock,
+        contains('permission-contents: write'),
+        reason: 'the least-privilege ceiling (contents:write — the tag '
+            're-push) must come from the honored input',
+      );
+      expect(
+        mintBlock,
+        isNot(contains(RegExp(r'^\s*permissions:', multiLine: true))),
+        reason: 'the composite `permissions` key is dead at this pin — '
+            'keeping it would overclaim a ceiling that does not exist',
+      );
+    });
+  });"}

# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   installer-portability → gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the POSIX-dialect proof
#               for the first-run wizard (site/** or the generator
#               touched) — dash + busybox ash on ubuntu, bash on macOS;
#               red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class

#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,

{"patch":"[test/release_flow_race_test.dart#A8C7]
INS.POST 924:
+
+  // ── gh-1561 rework — review threads 8/9/10 ─────────────────────────────
+  // Thread 8: read_published_version() must PROPAGATE failure — a command-
+  // substitution call site drops set -e (inherit_errexit is off), so an
+  // API outage used to read as published="" and could drive classification
+  // (worst case: the re-arm force-push) on NO data at all. Thread 9: the
+  // registration wait's fetch_runs is guarded like the terminal-wait loop
+  // (#1370 doctrine). Thread 10: the mint's least-privilege ceiling must
+  // ride an input the pinned action actually honors.
+  group('gh-1561 rework — pub.dev outage semantics + guarded registration wait', () {
+    test('pub.dev API down at the top of the leg -> loud classify failure', () {
+      // Pre-PR semantics restored (thread 8): the top-of-leg read ran in
+      // the main shell under set -e and one failed read exited loudly. The
+      // extracted helper must reproduce that — an outage must never read
+      // as published="" and slip into the behind-classification.
+      final r = runVerify('api-down-top', pubdevApiDown: true);
+      expect(r.exitCode, isNot(0), reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('::error::pub.dev API unreachable — cannot classify'),
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.status,
+        isNot('release-in-flight'),
+        reason: 'no data must never masquerade as a neutral skip',
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog,
+        isEmpty,
+        reason: 'the leg dies at the top read — no classification or '
+            'recovery reads on empty data',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('API outage must never fire the re-arm (no recovery on empty data)', () {
+      // The headline consequence from review thread 8: with published=""
+      // the old code classified «behind», reached the never-triggered arm
+      // and FORCE-PUSHED the tag purely because the API was unreachable.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'api-down-no-rearm',
+        tagAge: const Duration(hours: 2),
+        runsJson:
+            '[{"databaseId":777,"status":"completed","conclusion":"success","event":"release"}]',
+        rearmPushTo: 'origin',
+        pubdevApiDown: true,
+        extraEnv: const {'RELEASE_APP_TOKEN': 'stub-token'},
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, isNot(0), reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('::error::pub.dev API unreachable — cannot classify'),
+      );
+      expect(r.output, isNot(contains('re-armed')), reason: r.output);
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog.where((l) => l.contains('--branch v0.1.497')),
+        isEmpty,
+        reason: 'no run-list reads -> no re-arm decision, ever',
+      );
+      // The seeded 2h-backdated tag object is UNTOUCHED — the re-arm (a
+      // state-changing force-push + full ci.yml cascade) never fired.
+      final taggerDate = int.parse(
+        _gitOut([
+          'for-each-ref',
+          'refs/tags/v0.1.497',
+          '--format=%(creatordate:unix)',
+        ], cwd: r.origin),
+      );
+      final actual = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(
+        taggerDate * 1000,
+        isUtc: true,
+      );
+      expect(
+        actual.isBefore(
+          DateTime.now().toUtc().subtract(const Duration(minutes: 90)),
+        ),
+        isTrue,
+        reason: 'the seeded backdate survives — the re-arm never fired',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('pub.dev goes down mid-leg at the success re-read -> neutral skip', () {
+      // The second call site (thread 8): the top-of-leg reads serve the
+      // stale replica, the push run is green, then the API drops before the
+      // success-branch re-read — outcome UNOBSERVED, never a false
+      // «publish did not upload» and never a false green.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'api-down-success-reread',
+        runsJson:
+            '[{"databaseId":4242,"status":"completed","conclusion":"success","event":"push"}]',
+        curlFailAfterReads: 3,
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, 0, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.inFlight, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isFalse, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.output, contains('outcome unobserved'));
+      expect(r.output, isNot(contains('publish did not upload')));
+    });
+
+    test('transient gh failure inside the registration wait -> still-pending, '
+        'never a dead leg (thread 9)', () {
+      // The 4th branch-list read (the 2nd registration read) fails
+      // transiently — under set -e the unguarded assignment used to kill
+      // the leg exactly when the self-heal was mid-flight.
+      final r = runVerify(
+        'rearm-gh-blip',
+        tagAge: const Duration(hours: 2),
+        runsJson: '[]',
+        secondReadJson: '[]',
+        rearmPushTo: 'origin',
+        ghListFailOnRead: 4,
+        extraEnv: const {'RELEASE_APP_TOKEN': 'stub-token'},
+      );
+      expect(r.exitCode, 0, reason: 'a gh blip must not kill the leg: ${r.output}');
+      expect(r.inFlight, isTrue, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.errored, isFalse, reason: r.output);
+      expect(r.output, contains('was re-armed by this leg'));
+      expect(
+        r.output,
+        contains('transient gh failure reading the run list (attempt 2/6)'),
+        reason: r.output,
+      );
+      expect(
+        r.ghLog.where((l) => l.contains('--branch v0.1.497')),
+        hasLength(8),
+        reason: 'the failed read still consumed its registration attempt',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('wiring: the pubdev mint ceiling rides the WORKING granular input '
+        '(thread 10)', () {
+      // Verified against the pinned action (v3.2.0, bcd2ba49): action.yml
+      // defines NO composite `permissions` input (GitHub warns `Unexpected
+      // input(s) 'permissions'` and the action never reads it — the
+      // round-1 author reply was right), but it DOES define the generated
+      // `permission-*` inputs, which the action turns into the mint
+      // request's permissions map. The ceiling must ride the honored input.
+      final daily = read('.github/workflows/daily-publish.yml');
+      final mintAt = daily.indexOf('actions/create-github-app-token@');
+      expect(
+        mintAt,
+        greaterThan(-1),
+        reason: 'the pubdev leg mints the re-arm token',
+      );
+      final mintEnd = daily.indexOf('- name: Verify pub.dev', mintAt);
+      expect(mintEnd, greaterThan(mintAt));
+      final mintBlock = daily.substring(mintAt, mintEnd);
+      expect(
+        mintBlock,
+        contains('permission-contents: write'),
+        reason: 'the least-privilege ceiling (contents:write — the tag '
+            're-push) must come from the honored input',
+      );
+      expect(
+        mintBlock,
+        isNot(contains(RegExp(r'^\s*permissions:', multiLine: true))),
+        reason: 'the composite `permissions` key is dead at this pin — '
+            'keeping it would overclaim a ceiling that does not exist',
+      );
+    });
+  });"}

# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   installer-portability → gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the POSIX-dialect proof

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   installer-portability → gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the POSIX-dialect proof
#               for the first-run wizard (site/** or the generator
#               touched) — dash + busybox ash on ubuntu, bash on macOS;
#               red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
#               per-shard coverage merged to ONE report, junit durations
#               feed shard-rebalance.yml; goldens excluded as before)
#   faui-coverage → merge the 3 fa_ui shard reports into ONE lcov
#                   (issue #283 E3: the gate never sees 3 competing uploads)
#   quality-gate → ONE aggregate required check (skip-tolerant)
#   step-timings → per-step duration telemetry (jobs API → summary+artifact)
#   watchdog   → >2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out leg means a degraded
#                runner allocation → ONE empty-commit retrigger, never
#                `gh run rerun` (a rerun reallocates into the same pool)

# Tag-only / main-only jobs (publish, binaries, installer-smoke, release,

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Tag/schedule

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   installer-portability → gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the POSIX-dialect proof
#               for the first-run wizard (site/** or the generator
#               touched) — dash + busybox ash on ubuntu, bash on macOS;
#               red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
#               per-shard coverage merged to ONE report, junit durations
#               feed shard-rebalance.yml; goldens excluded as before)
#   faui-coverage → merge the 3 fa_ui shard reports into ONE lcov
#                   (issue #283 E3: the gate never sees 3 competing uploads)
#   quality-gate → ONE aggregate required check (skip-tolerant)
#   step-timings → per-step duration telemetry (jobs API → summary+artifact)
#   watchdog   → >2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out leg means a degraded
#                runner allocation → ONE empty-commit retrigger, never
#                `gh run rerun` (a rerun reallocates into the same pool)
#   release-pending → gh-1551 empty-tick short-circuit: the schedule is
#                the release arming mechanism (gh-1537), but a tick with
#                no commits since the last v* tag skips the whole gate
#                in seconds (see the job comment below)
# Tag-only / main-only jobs (publish, binaries, installer-smoke, release,
#   integration) are unchanged in semantics — they just need the new aggregate.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{"patch":"[scripts/verify_pubdev_release.sh#A9F2]
SWAP 121.=133:
+read_published_version() {
+  local acc="" v attempt ok=1
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    if v=$(curl -fsS --retry 3 \
+      https://pub.dev/api/packages/flutter_agent_harness | jq -r '.latest.version'); then
+      ok=0
+    fi
+    acc=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$acc" "$v" | sed '/^$/d' | sort -V | tail -1)
+    [ "$attempt" = 3 ] || sleep "$read_sleep"
+  done
+  # gh-1561 rework (review thread 8): a command-substitution subshell does
+  # NOT inherit set -e (inherit_errexit is off), so a failing loop would
+  # silently fall through to the printf — propagating an empty read into
+  # the classification. Return the failure explicitly; callers decide.
+  [ "$ok" -eq 0 ] || return 1
+  printf '%s' "$acc"
+}
+
+# Top of the leg — the pre-PR inline loop ran in the main shell under
+# set -e: one failed read exited the leg loudly. Preserve that (thread 8):
+# NO data must never classify, and never drive rerun/re-arm recovery.
+published=$(read_published_version) || {
+  echo "::error::pub.dev API unreachable — cannot classify"
+  exit 1
+}"}

    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need

    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),

    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.

# green — never a silent absence, never 35-40 min for an empty tick).
    - cron: '23 */2 * * *'

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Tag/schedule
# runs are never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   installer-portability → gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the POSIX-dialect proof
#               for the first-run wizard (site/** or the generator
#               touched) — dash + busybox ash on ubuntu, bash on macOS;
#               red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Tag/schedule
# runs are never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   installer-portability → gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the POSIX-dialect proof
#               for the first-run wizard (site/** or the generator
#               touched) — dash + busybox ash on ubuntu, bash on macOS;
#               red blocks the merge via the quality-gate platform class
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
#               per-shard coverage merged to ONE report, junit durations
#               feed shard-rebalance.yml; goldens excluded as before)
#   faui-coverage → merge the 3 fa_ui shard reports into ONE lcov
#                   (issue #283 E3: the gate never sees 3 competing uploads)
#   quality-gate → ONE aggregate required check (skip-tolerant)
#   step-timings → per-step duration telemetry (jobs API → summary+artifact)
#   watchdog   → >2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out leg means a degraded
#                runner allocation → ONE empty-commit retrigger, never
#                `gh run rerun` (a rerun reallocates into the same pool)
#   release-pending → gh-1551 empty-tick short-circuit: the schedule is
#                the release arming mechanism (gh-1537), but a tick with
#                no commits since the last v* tag skips the whole gate
#                in seconds (see the job comment below)
# Tag-only / main-only jobs (publish, binaries, installer-smoke, release,
#   integration) are unchanged in semantics — they just need the new aggregate.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

+read_published_version() {
+  local acc="" v attempt ok=1
+  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    if v=$(curl -fsS --retry 3 \

+  [ "$ok" -eq 0 ] || return 1
